artworks.title: Bagpipe Players
artworks.artist: Martin Treu
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person playing a bagpipe. The drawing features a person playing a bagpipe instrument. The person is sitting and wearing period-specific attire. The person appears intent on their music. The background includes a textured ground surface and vegetation. The artwork has a rustic, vintage feel with cross-hatching used for shading.

artworks.title: Dancing Couple, Facing Left
artworks.artist: Martin Treu
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays two people walking together. The woman on the left has her arm raised and gesturing forward, showing detailed facial features with a prominent nose and styled hair pulled back and twisted into a roll. She wears a textured dress with long sleeves and a striped apron, and her other arm is linked with the man beside her. The man, positioned slightly behind and to the right of the woman, has a bearded face with long, wavy hair. He is dressed in medieval attire with a tunic, belt, and a sword hanging from it. His arms are bent, with one hand holding onto the woman's arm. The background has a simple textured pattern, emphasizing the figures as the focal point of the image.

artworks.title: Embracing Couple
artworks.artist: Martin Treu
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a man and a woman, standing close to each other. The man wears a hat and tunic with a sword, holding a staff. The woman wears a detailed dress with a headscarf and carries a bag and cane. The background is textured, and the image includes various markings like an 'M' and '9' in the upper left corner, and 'B23' in the bottom right.

artworks.title: Astronomy
artworks.artist: Cornelis Jacobsz Drebbel, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving featuring two figures in a half-length view. The central figure is a young person seated, gazing upward with a serene expression. She has wavy hair and is dressed in a loose-fitting garment with a chain around her neck. The other figure to the right is an elderly person leaning closer, holding a scientific instrument up to the sky. This person has a lined face and wears a cap. In their other hand, they hold a spherical armillary. The scene is set against a detailed background with a stone building, windows, and a starry night sky. There is also a portion of a celestial chart or globe visible.

artworks.title: Arithmetic
artworks.artist: Cornelis Jacobsz Drebbel, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows two people from the waist up. The person on the left is seated and is slightly turned toward the person on the right. They have delicate facial features and are adorned with curled hair, partially covered by a flowing cloth that drapes over the head like a veil. This person wears a garment with loose fabric draped over one shoulder, adorned with a patterned band on the upper arm. The person's breast is partially exposed. The individual on the right is leaning in closely, peering at a tablet that the left person holds. This person wears a soft, rounded hat with a brim and has curly hair peeking out from underneath, along with a high-necked tunic. There is an inkstand with a quill on a table in the foreground. The background features a wall with shelves filled with books and papers.

artworks.title: Philosophy
artworks.artist: Cornelis Jacobsz Drebbel, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16.1 x 13.1 cm (6 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: Two individuals are shown from the waist up, engaged in a conversation. The person on the left is an elderly man with a long beard and cap, wearing a robe and gesturing with his left hand. The person on the right is a woman with curly hair, wearing a gown with puffy sleeves. She has her hands raised and there are books in her lap. The background includes columns and what appear to be scrolls or books.

artworks.title: Poetry
artworks.artist: Cornelis Jacobsz Drebbel, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 16 x 13.2 cm (6 5/16 x 5 3/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man seated. The woman is facing slightly to the side, wearing a cap, short hair, a beaded necklace, and a patterned cloth with fur trim. The man has a bushy beard, receding hairline, wearing a long robe and holding a staff with two snakes, a caduceus. In the background are ornate walls and a column or furniture. The lines and etching technique give the composition a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Henricus Steenwyck
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image displays the upper body of a man facing the viewer with a sideways glance. He has long hair, a mustache, and a beard. He wears an elaborate garment with a high collar and voluminous sleeves, ending in ruffled cuffs. He holds a sheet of paper or fabric in his left hand, with his right hand poised above it. The background is a textured, lined pattern. The name "Henricus Steenwyck" is inscribed beneath the image.

artworks.title: Gaspar de Crayer
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is looking at the viewer, with a slightly turned pose. His right hand is resting on his chest with fingers splayed. The man has a robust facial structure, a prominent nose, a mustache, and slightly curly hair falling above his shoulders. He wears a dark robe with puffy sleeves, a white ruffled collar, indicating a formal and wealthy setting. The background has a textured pattern resembling a sky with clouds. The subject is identified as Gaspar de Crayer, with Ant. van Dyck as the painter and Paul du Pont as the engraver.

artworks.title: The Book of the Law Read before the People
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a grand architectural setting. The central figure is standing on a raised platform in front of large columns, extending a hand towards an open book being held by two figures. The surrounding figures are adorned in robes and helmets, displaying varied gestures. The architectural backdrop features classical elements such as columns, archways, and a relief sculpture of galloping horses, emphasizing an ancient or classical theme. The composition is symmetrical, and the detailed engraving work adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Destruction of the Temple of Baal and the Slaughter of His Priests
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient scene depicting chaos and destruction. The image shows multiple figures in a classical architectural setting. At the top, a central, crowned figure gives commands while figures around them carry out orders. The lower part of the scene contains action, with individuals engaged in combat, wielding swords, and dragging others. Additional figures carry objects away, such as vessels. The work involves detailing in the clothing, musculature, and architectural elements, with text at the bottom providing context or description of the scene. The towers and domes in the background, along with the burning cityscape, enhance the dramatic atmosphere of this historical narrative.

artworks.title: The Slaughter of the Priests of Samaria
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in an ancient architectural setting. The central figure in a crown stands at the forefront, interacting with others around a large architectural structure with columns and an archway. Figures are shown in dynamic poses, engaged in acts that suggest conflict or punishment. Statuesque figures with wings sit atop a platform. The scene is rich with details such as the stone floor texture, armor, garments, and architectural depth.

artworks.title: Josiah Celebrating Passover
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in classical attire in a scene involving a ritual or feast. The drawing shows figures in robes and armor, some carrying weapons, gathered around tables filled with food in a grand hall with arches and pillars. The setting includes various postures and activities, with some figures in movement and others in conversation. There are animals present, integrated into the scene. The architectural background and draped fabric add depth and texture, creating a ceremonial or narrative atmosphere. The drawing combines storytelling elements with classical artistic motifs, capturing a dense, dynamic moment.

artworks.title: Suleiman the Magnificent Forced to Raise the Siege of Vienna
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This image shows a battle scene with knights and horses. The drawing depicts armored knights on horseback in the foreground engaged in combat. The horses are equipped with armor and decorations. In the background, there are more figures fighting, creating a chaotic battlefield. The image includes details of armor, weapons, and a cityscape with spired buildings. The composition conveys the movement and intensity of a historical battle, capturing the scale and environment of combat.

artworks.title: The Surrender of John Frederick, Elector of Saxony, After the Battle of Mühlberg
artworks.artist: Dirck Volckertz Coornhert, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored group with horses amid a lush landscape. The scene depicts armored figures, both mounted and on foot, engaging in preparation or strategic discussions. The engravings showcase ornate armor and elaborate horse adornments, indicating a scene from a historical or mythical battle. The background features a landscape with mountains, trees, armies in formation, and structures from an encampment or village. The artistry conveys tension and readiness, capturing the grandeur of medieval warfare or chivalry.

artworks.title: Honest and Dishonest Ways of Becoming Rich
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seven allegorical figures. Each figure is labeled with a name above their head, arranged in a line from left to right. The figures are named "Fortuna," "Labor," "Diligentia," "Parsimonia," "Fraus," "Mendacium," and "Vis." "Fortuna" is depicted as a blindfolded, winged female figure holding a vessel and a rudder. "Labor" is a muscular figure with wings holding a spade. "Diligentia" is an elderly woman carrying a spindle. "Parsimonia" holds a purse. "Fraus" is shown with a theatrical mask and a dagger. "Mendacium" is depicted in a sinister cloak. "Vis" is dressed as a soldier with a staff or spear. The figures are detailed, with expressive postures conveying various human traits and vices. The style is reminiscent of Northern Renaissance or Mannerist artworks.

artworks.title: Notorious Examples of Wealth from Antiquity
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image depicts six individuals standing in full-body view. They each have unique poses and wear attire reflecting historical or mythological themes. From left to right, the first person wears a robe, has a beard, and holds a staff. The second person wears armor and holds a scepter. The third person is inspecting something in their hand. The central figure wears detailed armor, a helmet, and holds a staff with a fierce head. The fifth figure wears royal robes, has a beard, and holds a staff with a lion head. The last person on the right wears a crown, holds a staff, and is dressed in detailed garments. The background is plain, emphasizing the characters.

artworks.title: The Deceptive Effects of Wealth
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing with a collection of symbolic figures and elements, intricately detailed in a monochromatic tone. On the left, a figure labeled "Honos" holds a smoking vessel. Beside him is "Splendor," who holds a horn and is adorned with luxurious garments. To the right, a larger-than-life figure named "Fama" blows a horn. In the background, a group of figures labeled "Parasiti" appear engaged in a social or economic exchange. Each character is drawn with attention to the folds of their clothing and the textures of their attributes. Below the scene, a Latin inscription serves as an epigram that contextualizes the allegory, touching on themes of vanity, esteem, and the fleeting nature of fame. This work employs classical allegorical elements to convey its themes.

artworks.title: Dangers and Vices Accompanying Wealth
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: There is a drawing of an allegorical scene with various personified elements. The scene presents several figures with labels such as "Periculum," "Pavor," "Latrocinium," "Regina Pecunia," "Stultitia," "Tristitia," and "Invidia." The drawing depicts a narrative scene where several characters interact with each other. The central figure "Regina Pecunia" sits regally on a throne or carriage. The figures around her, each labeled with their Latin descriptors, contribute to conveying the themes of human vices or misfortunes. The overall composition is intricate, with detailed engravings depicting the emotions and characteristics symbolized by the figures. The cloudy background and complex poses add to the richness and depth of the allegory being depicted.

artworks.title: Dianae Ephesiae Templum (The Temple of Diana at Ephesus)
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient temple and its surrounding activities. The detailed illustration features an ornate temple building prominently in the center, constructed with large columns and adorned with various statues and reliefs. In the foreground, a group of figures is depicted engaging in stone carving and construction work, using tools on large stone blocks. Behind the temple, there are mountainous landscapes with a radiating light effect. The entire composition reflects an homage to classical antiquity, showcasing the grandeur and meticulous artistry associated with historic architecture.

artworks.title: Babylonis Muri (The Walls of Babylon)
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an overhead view of ancient Babylon. The scene includes the city layout, hills, mountains, intricate architecture, figures, ships, a central tall structure, staircase, obelisk, statues, lion, figure on horseback with a spear, terraced gardens, waterways, and a bridge over a river. The color scheme is primarily sepia tones.

artworks.title: Olympy Iovis Simulacrum (The Statue of Jupiter at Olympia)
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.4 x 27.2 cm (8 13/16 x 10 11/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient ceremonial gathering. A large statue of a seated figure is the focal point. The statue is positioned in a grand architectural setting with columns and alcoves. The statue holds a staff and is surrounded by intricately carved accompaniments, possibly representing mythological scenes or deities. Below the statue are numerous figures engaged in various activities. Some are depicted in dynamic poses, demonstrating physical feats or gestures of veneration towards the statue. The scene suggests a blend of reverence and athletic spectacle. On the left side, there is a detailed tree and an individual holding a laurel wreath. The right side includes additional statuary and individuals in conversation. The drawing is rendered with fine line work and elaborate shading, typical of traditional engravings.

artworks.title: Pharos (The Lighthouse at Alexandria)
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.2 x 27.5 cm (8 3/4 x 10 13/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a coastal city. In the bottom right corner, closest to us, there are two men and two children gathered on a ledge overlooking the landscape. One of the men wears a crown and holds what looks like a knife, and in front of him another man with laurels in his hair holds up a large tablet. In the distance, a tall circular architectural structure labeled "Pharos" stands on a rocky island, with smoke appearing to flow from arched openings at the top of the structure. Several ships and boats are visible in the sea, with large, swirling waves surrounding them. Below the large structure on the rock is a city connected to a long road that winds from the center of the print to another city in the upper right corner, extending into the distance towards jagged mountains. The cities feature winding streets, tall buildings, and towers. The sky is filled with swirling clouds, with a crescent moon casting light on the scene to the left. There are several lines of text below the print.

artworks.title: Piramides Aegypti (The Pyramids of Egypt)
artworks.artist: Philip Galle, after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 22.3 x 26.5 cm (8 3/4 x 10 7/16 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Estate of Leo Steinberg
